configurePresets.name: default
configurePresets.description: Standard Linux platform, Release build with examples. Use inside the dev container or when all dependencies are installed locally.

configurePresets.name: debug
configurePresets.description: Standard Linux platform, Debug build with full assertions.

configurePresets.name: evl
configurePresets.description: EVL/Xenomai 4 platform backend. Requires CoreRaT built with EVL support in the sysroot (present in ratos-dev-image). Tests and examples disabled; use evl-cross for a full build.

configurePresets.name: evl-cross
configurePresets.description: Build for the RaTOS EVL target using the RaTOS ISAR SDK sysroot. CoreRaT with EVL support is pre-installed in the SDK. The SDK is downloaded and extracted automatically by scripts/evl-dev.sh --cross.
